notes.title: BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH - RELEASE DATE ANNOUCEMENT
notes.content:
We're super excited to share that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/][b][i]BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH[/i][/b][/url], the next chapter in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][i][b]BrokenLore[/b][/i][/url] series, is coming to Steam on [b]March 20th, 2025[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351330/BrokenLore_DONT_WATCH/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/68e0454c875a4fbef737b42e49a3e544f601912d.png[/img]

This time, we're diving into the tough subject of social anxiety, with Shinji as our main character. He’s a young hikikomori, living in isolation in his Tokyo apartment, struggling with the outside world.

[previewyoutube=BdNmf29ECOw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven’t already, be sure to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3014520/BrokenLore_LOW/][i][b]BrokenLore: LOW[/b][/i][/url], the first chapter of the series, which we released recently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215569/ac5e68c8f2eeb4826d87569dbfb9376524a9b6a5.png[/img]

notes.title: BrokenLore: FOLLOW x HORROR GAME AWARDS
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][b]BrokenLore: FOLLOW[/b][/url] is a psychological horror game that delves into the complex relationship between a mother and daughter. The title is being developed in collaboration with a psychologist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899545/b7873626e1c13b0808a8604e970f3950fff9cf68.gif[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][b]FOLLOW[/b][/url] features photorealistic environments and a story-driven adventure, with a strong focus on the mythology and the meaning of colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899545/638844b3fc7dc6ab69a47ed9b27fc90cfe63fa3d.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][b]FOLLOW[/b][/url] is only one of the entries in their new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini][i][b]BrokenLore[/b][/i][/url] series that focus on philosophical themes and psychological horror.

notes.title: Is FOLLOW connected to UNFOLLOW?
notes.content:
Welcome to FOLLOW! We're thrilled to have you join us.

We'd like to delve deeper into the significance of this title and its connection to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133830/UNFOLLOW/]UNFOLLOW[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899545/728e518d266678ea60ab72ea00cc4a9932a15502.png[/img]

FOLLOW will offer a standalone narrative experience, independent of UNFOLLOW. 

Similarly, UNFOLLOW can be enjoyed without prior knowledge of FOLLOW.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899545/6325a93a481d739782a631de8c0a7917d2a78415.png[/img]

The creation of this new story aims to provide a more immersive psychological horror. 

FOLLOW will closely resemble the experience of the FIRST DEMO of UNFOLLOW.

Details regarding the themes and unique elements of this title will be unveiled in due course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44899545/ee3a996aa51ebcd4bf8ace77ea5b2624d82f0674.png[/img]

In April, an exclusive build will be made available to select users. 

If you're interested, simply express your interest under our latest post on X. 
You can find the link here: [url=https://x.com/UNFOLLOW_GAME/status/1762198022421618725?s=20]https://x.com/UNFOLLOW_GAME/[/url]

Help us expand on Steam by adding FOLLOW to your wishlist and following our page. 
We truly appreciate your support.
